entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • OpenAPI generation throws InvalidCastException for uint property with [DefaultValue(0)] #65050
  • offline support for blazor server #65045
  • How to avoid loading configuration providers multiple times when manipulating configuration sources in WebApplicationBuilder/ConfigurationManager? #65041
  • TempData design proposal #65039
    .NET 11 Planning
  • The resource <URL> was preloaded using link preload but not used within a few seconds from the window's load event. With custom Libraries #65036
  • There are some warnings “A preload for 'http://localhost:xxxx/_framework/blazor.webassembly.u5pmnvwhn0.js' is found..." in browser console when running 11.0 Blazor WebAssembly Standalone project #65035
  • After installing .NET 11.0 SDK, Running the 10.0 Blazor WebAssembly - memory access out of bounds during HotReload init #65034
  • After installing .NET 11.0 SDK, Running the 10.0 Blazor Web project the Weather page keep Loading... with error "GET http://localhost:5049/_framework/blazor.web.js #65033
  • There is a warning "warning NETSDK1224: ASP.NET Core framework assets are not supported for the target framework." when creating 10.0 Blazor project after installing .NET 11.0 SDK #65032
  • There is a warning "Failed to read or parse localization file "(content/RazorClassLibrary-CSharp/.template.config/localize/templatestrings.en.json)"When creating the first 11.0 web project #65030

Closed

  • There are two warning EF8001: 'RelationalOwnedNavigationBuilderExtensions.ToJson(OwnedNavigationBuilder, string?)' is obsolete when building the 11.0 Blazor web IndAuth project #65018
  • None Include in .csproj don't work for subdirectory under wwwroot #65021
